types.name: Opposite face from positions
types.description: Two, three or four positions (views) of the same die are shown, and you find the face opposite a given face, or the face on top when a given face is at the bottom.

types.name: Opposite face in an open net
types.description: An unfolded sheet (net) of a cube is shown, and you find which face will be opposite a given face after folding.

types.name: Matching a net with a cube
types.description: You choose which cube can (or cannot) be formed by folding a given net, or which net gives a shown cube or box.

types.name: Painted and cut cubes
types.description: A cube (or cuboid) is painted and cut into small cubes, and you count pieces with 0, 1, 2 or 3 painted faces, or find the colours needed to paint a cube.
